newsitem.title: USA: Albright firm on Hong Kong, China trade with U.S..
newsitem.headline: Albright firm on Hong Kong, China trade with U.S..

text.p: Secretary of State-designate Madeleine Albright has maintained a firm line on China relating to Hong Kong and trade issues.

In written answers to more than 200 questions posed by the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, she asserted the need for "up-front commitments from China to expand market access significantly for our exporters and investors as part of" Beijing's bid for membership in the World Trade Organization.
Albright also said "we have no intention of exempting China from our anti-dumping laws."
